DMSchema.description: Custom attributes to indicate BIS concepts.

DMEnumeration.description: Defines the layers in the BIS schema hierarchy.

DMEnumerator.name: Core
DMEnumerator.description: Layer for schemas that define the most fundamental concepts and key organizational strategies for all other BIS schemas.

DMEnumerator.name: Common
DMEnumerator.description: Layer for schemas that define abstract concepts and patterns used by multiple disciplines.

DMEnumerator.name: DisciplinePhysical
DMEnumerator.description: Layer for schemas that focus on physical/spatial and closely associated concepts, in light of a specific discipline.

DMEnumerator.name: DisciplineOther
DMEnumerator.description: Layer for schemas that define concepts from modeling perspectives other than physical, in light of a specific discipline.

DMEnumerator.name: Application
DMEnumerator.description: Layer for schemas that define concepts that no other schema would need or want to reference.

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Declares the target layer in the BIS schema hierarchy for a schema.

DMProperty.description: Layer in the BIS schema hierarchy that a schema targets.
